verdict.rationale: Sentry offers a self-hosted, historically open-source deployment (sentry-docs-28) and REST API endpoints for issues/events (sentry-docs-23) that could be used to extract data, giving some data-portability path. However there is no documented 'export all your data' feature and community evidence shows real friction with the openness claim (a user citing closed-source license changes and vendor lock-in as reasons to leave/build alternatives). Missing for 10: an explicit data-export/backup tool with open formats, clear guarantee of full data portability, and resolution of the lock-in/licensing concerns raised by users.
